admission.justification: The detector and adoption gate together prevent attributed converted trees containing unanchored old-format cards; drift acceptance must not erase that boundary.

applicability: First attributed baseline status/adoption of a converted memory tree without an existing attributed baseline.
conditions: Legacy signs are metadata-key first cells doc_type / lastVerifiedCommitHash / lastVerifiedCommitDate, plain or backticked, and a level-two Update History heading.
The result lists affected cards; correcting them permits the normal adoption checks.
accept_drift waives stale anchors only, not legacy-card or validator refusals.
exclusions: Ordinary validator rules for an already-adopted repository.
Prose/code mentions in a later table cell.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_bootstrap_converted_onboarding.py (all-sign positives through status and adoption with both accept_drift values, prose/code-mention negatives, correction rerun adopts, adopted trees stay adopted)

L45-M1-F01: the previous PRF-1PFM1K exact-already-adopted facet is withdrawn as stronger than its assertion. Its historical producer evidence remains immutable. The replacement describes the complete test assertion, not a fresh execution.

statement: The first baseline of a converted tree holds no old-format card: status and adoption report blocked-legacy-cards with the cards, and accept_drift never lifts it.
